source: Primary: https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/theme-color (fetched 2026-09-10, page footer dated 9/9/2026), parsed for every <code> key under each <h2> section = 910 unique ids. Cross-check: /Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/out/vs/workbench/workbench.desktop.main.js (VS Code 1.136.1, commit a44adf7f53e00964ab890f9f8758a334f1fc15bc), statically parsed for registerColor()-shaped call expressions `("id", <defaults>, <description>)` where <description> is either an nls index call `d(NUM,null)` (resolved against /Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/out/nls.messages.json, a flat 0-indexed global string table) or a literal string. 945 such calls matched after excluding non-color registries that share the same call shape (context keys, config settings, design tokens, dom-builder tag.class ids, command ids) -- see research notes for the exact filters. Plus 16 terminal.ansi* colors parsed from a dedicated id->{index,defaults} map literal, and 7 dotless base colors (contrastBorder, contrastActiveBorder, focusBorder, foreground, disabledForeground, errorForeground, descriptionForeground) recovered by direct substring search (the dotted-id regex excludes them by construction). 988 total unique keys: 890 confirmed in both docs and bundle, 20 docs-only (extension-contributed gitDecoration.*/git.blame.* from the built-in git extension, gauge.* and two dynamically-suffixed *.sashBorder ids not found as static string literals in this particular bundle file), and 78 bundle-only ids not yet documented on the reference page (new Agent Sessions panel, a 'modern' activity-bar/tab redesign behind development, chat voice/find-match colors, etc.).
methodologyNotes: defaults.* values: a literal hex/rgba string extracted directly from the bundle is given as-is (e.g. "#1E1E1E").

A value of the form "@some.color.id" means the bundle aliases this variant to another color's registration (best-effort static alias resolution via a variable-name symbol table built over the same bundle; ~899 variable bindings resolved). Look up that id in this same file for its own default.

A value of the form "expr:..." is a partially-resolved JS expression (alpha/lighten/darken helper calls whose minified names were not reverse-engineered, e.g. pi(@foreground,.7)); read it as 'a transform of the referenced color', not a literal.

A value of the form "$name" is an unresolved minified local identifier (28 residual values out of ~3950 resolved fields) -- the source expression exists in the bundle but this script's symbol table did not capture its definition.

null means the color has no default for that theme kind in the bundle (falls through to another color or is intentionally unset), OR (for the 20 docs-only keys) no bundle data could be statically extracted at all.

source: "docs+bundle" = id confirmed on both the docs page and via a structurally-matched registerColor call in the bundle. "docs" = documented but not found as a static string literal in this bundle file (see notes above). "bundle" = found in the bundle via the same structural match but not present on the docs page as of 2026-09-10 (undocumented/new).
